dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Huh... This place has some similarities with the Abyss — a fully independent realm, separated from the outside world.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to stay awhile. Make sure you leave plenty of open space for me to use. That way, I won't run the risk of damaging the landscape or buildings during my sword practice.
